products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI platform that describes itself as offering image and video generation, editing, and enhancement tools. The platform aggregates a range of third-party AI models alongside its own capabilities, giving users access to video generation from providers including ByteDance, Google, Minimax, Alibaba, and others through a single interface. Supported video models include ByteDance's Seedance Studio, which the site describes as producing cinematic 30-second clips at up to 1080p with native synchronized audio and region-level editing, as well as Google's Veo and Gemini Omni video models, Minimax's frontier model rendering at 2K, and Alibaba's latest generation model supporting clips up to 30 seconds at up to 1080p with up to 10 reference images, 5 reference videos, and 5 reference audios. Image generation models available through the platform include FLUX 3, which the site says renders up to 20 seconds in a single pass with multilingual speech and multi-scene support, Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Image with support for up to 4K resolution, and a Qwen model described as offering enhanced human realism and improved text rendering.

The held facts list Krea's primary tracked product as Krea AI, categorized under video generation and editing and noted as a real-time video generation and creative tool with content moderation features. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
